import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { DEFAULT_PAGE, EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_PAGE } from '@src/constants/common';
import { getMyHiddenSkillBooks } from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/hidden/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { parsePageNumber } from '@src/utils/commandParser';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { formatSkillBookListItem } from '@src/utils/skillBookHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  const messageText = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?我的隐藏功法\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();
  const args = messageText ? messageText.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const parseResult = parsePageNumber(args, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, DEFAULT_PAGE);
  const page = parseResult.success ? parseResult.value! : DEFAULT_PAGE;

  const result = await getMyHiddenSkillBooks({ bid, uid, page });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '我的隐藏功法', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const { items, total, totalPages, currentPage } = result.data;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (total === 0) {
    md.addText('暂无隐藏功法');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡可在 /我的功法 中使用 /隐藏功法 ID');
  } else if (items.length === 0) {
    md.addText('❌ 页码超出范围');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`当前共有 ${total} 本隐藏功法，请输入 1-${totalPages} 之间的页码`);
  } else {
    items.forEach(item => {
      md.addText(formatSkillBookListItem(item, item.id));

      addOptions(md, [
        { label: '显示', command: `/显示功法 ${item.id}` },
        { label: '查看', command: `/查看功法 ${item.id}` }
      ]);
    });
  }

  const nav =
    total > 0 ? { current: items.length === 0 ? MIN_PAGE : currentPage, total: totalPages, count: total, command: '/我的隐藏功法 {page}' } : undefined;

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '我的隐藏功法',
      header: [{ label: '我的功法', command: '/我的功法' }],
      content: md,
      nav
    })
  );
});

export default response;
